name: Christmas no Shiawase na Ouchi
original_name: クリスマスのしあわせなおうち
source:
Tomorrow is Christmas!
I should ask Santa for a present!
What should I ask for~?

I was a good girl, so Santa will surely give me a present!

That's what they said.
They said. Said. Said.

That's why.

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/16450]Freem![/url]]
translation:
明天就是圣诞节了！
我应该向圣诞老人要礼物！
我应该要求什么~？

我是个好女孩，圣诞老人一定会给我礼物的！

他们就是这么说的。
他们说。说。说。

这就是原因。

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/16450]Freem![/url]]
